topic: Smart Beta, Quant Funds and other Non-Traditional Index Funds
source_evidence: These funds will not necessarily outperform the market or even perform comparably to the market.
question: Misconception: A smart beta fund uses factors, so it is guaranteed to outperform the market.
answer: Using factors such as value, dividends, or quality does not guarantee outperformance. A smart beta fund may seek to outperform, but it may not outperform—or even perform comparably to—the market.
